verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own task system covers part of this story. A hands-on user praises its quickly configurable task statuses, and the docs show tasks can be created and managed and given custom task types, which could represent initiatives. Priority and an owning-team field are never explicitly documented; custom fields and the Triage Agent's bug prioritization only hint at them. Missing for 10: documented priority field on tasks or initiatives, documented team-ownership assignment, an explicit initiative-level tracking feature, and independent corroboration of the full workflow.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track initiatives with status, priority, and an owning team

citations.quote: one thing I love about ClickUp is its ability to quickly configure task statuses
You can use [Create Task] to set the custom task type on a task as you create it.
Using the ClickUp API, you can create, update, and manage tasks programmatically.
